name: bugfix_parry
description: Logic bug fix: the parry value does not match its description. Changes BUFF_Parry DamageReduction from 0.8 to 0.2 so the buff absorbs 80% of incoming damage and lets 20% through, matching the existing "absorbing 80% of the damage" text. Single-byte equal-length in-place edit; file size and internal offsets are unchanged.
source: Clean Steam baseline, Build 1837603 (edited in place; no assets from refs/PC_EE are referenced).
grading: L0: equal length, single-byte change, uniqueness assertion (only one 0.8f in the asset), and readback of 0.2f; L1: property table re-readable by the same parser. L2/L3 in-game not verified. Confirmed byte-level location; gameplay value set to 0.2.
install_note: Overwrite the game file at the matching relative_path (back up the original first). To roll back, verify the original against the manifest's src_sha256 and restore it.
